title: pamoja rules
description: Rules between nodes: when one topic's reading crosses a line, drive an output or publish a message, and undo it once the reading comes back.

$schema.description: The format the file is written in: this schema's address, or a copy of it by the same file name. An editor reads it to check the file as it is typed.

rules.description: The rules, checked against each reading in the order they are listed.

rule.description: One rule: a line through one topic's readings, and what to do as a reading crosses it and comes back.

name.description: A name no other rule in the file has, such as water-when-dry. The engine reports it when the rule fires.

then.description: What to do once, the moment the condition becomes true.

otherwise.description: What to do once, the moment the condition stops holding.

condition.description: The line a topic's readings cross. It names one side, above or below.

topic.description: The topic whose readings are watched, exactly as the node publishes to it. One topic, so no + or # wildcards.

above.description: The condition holds while readings are above this line.

below.description: The condition holds while readings are below this line.

hysteresis.description: How far back past the line a reading must come for the condition to clear, so readings hovering at the line do not fire it over and over.

action.description: One thing a rule does: drive an output, or publish a message.

oneOf.title: drive
oneOf.description: Switches an output the program running the rules holds under this name.

drive.description: The output's name, such as bed-valve.

on.description: true to switch it on, false to switch it off.

oneOf.title: publish
oneOf.description: Publishes a message over the link the rules run on.

publish.description: The topic to publish to. One topic, so no + or # wildcards.
